Article 5-2 (Special Cases concerning Filling Positions of Secretaries, etc.)
Notwithstanding Articles 4-2 (2) and 5 (2), where special circumstances exist, each secretary and the Head of the National Crisis Management Center may instead be appointed from among the following persons:
1. Foreign service officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or public officials of the Ministry of Unification who belong to the Senior Civil Service;
2. Active-duty military officers of the Ministry of National Defense or employees of the National Intelligence Service holding positions equivalent to those referred to in subparagraph 1.
